item.title: Illouz to ‘Post’: Netanyahu must pay political price for October 7 - interview
item.description: Former Likud MK and Yisrael Beytenu candidate Dan Illouz discusses what originally drew him to Likud, the October 7 massacre, and what ultimately led him to join Avigdor Liberman’s Yisrael Beytenu.

item.title: 'Twisted Torah': Israeli leaders criticize Rabbi Lando's anti-Zionist views
item.description: "The statements of Rabbi Lando against the fallen of religious Zionism who died to save us all are shame and disgrace," former prime minister Naftali Bennett responded.

item.title: Israel must be ready for any threat, no matter how unthinkable it may seem - editorial
item.description: October 7 should have permanently lowered Israel’s tolerance for vulnerabilities whose consequences could be catastrophic.

item.title: Ex-hostage Avinatan Or attempted escape during time in Hamas captivity
item.description: "In the army they always told us, there's no such thing as a 100% perfect defense, there will always be some weak point," he explained.

item.title: Former hostage Emily Damari calls out denial, distortion of October 7, thanks British supporters
item.description: "It was not an accident," Damari said in a video released on Monday. "It was a planned terrorist attack, in which innocent people were murdered, raped, injured, and kidnapped from their homes."

item.title: Antisemitic conspiracy theories spread after attempted flydubai hijacking
item.description: Conspiracy theories about the attempted flydubai hijacking spread within hours, invoking antisemitic tropes despite passenger accounts.

item.title: UK to expel 27 Israeli diplomats if east Jerusalem consulate closed, British diplomats expelled
item.description: UK National Security Adviser Jonathan Powell held talks with Israeli officials but failed to reach an agreement to keep the consulate open, Reuters cited sources as saying.

item.title: Brad Pitt on screen, retired IDF combat dogs in the seats
item.description: HaHolchim BaRosh arranged the screening; it supports Oketz veterans as they transition into civilian life and maintains a community for former unit members.

item.title: Who will teach the next generation?
item.description: A Jerusalem summit will bring together more than 300 educators from Israel and around the world to share ideas, confront common challenges, and strengthen the connections that sustain Jewish life.

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: Israel continues to face major mental health struggles in wake of October 7, ERAN data show
item.description: In the three years since the war began, over 928,000 people have been aided by ERAN's professional mental health teams, assisted by 1,850 volunteers.

item.title: Haredi protest erupts in Modi'in after Military Police move to arrest draft dodger, police announce
item.description: Footage of the scene shared by Israeli media showed numerous haredi (ultra-Orthodox) men protesting and clashing with police officers.

item.title: IAF soldiers reveal air force's initial response to flydubai attempted hijacking
item.description: A reservist serving as head of national airspace defense in the Air Control Array said the aircraft was first detected between Saudi Arabia and Jordan and appeared to be heading for Tel Aviv.

item.title: Israeli lecturer indicted for planning mass terror attack against Palestinians, Arab Israelis
item.description: The accused, a mathematics lecturer in his 60s at Bar-Ilan University, was charged with preparing to commit an act of terrorism, extortion by threats, and obstruction of justice.

item.title: New mural in Tel Aviv shows Bart Simpson as a Hamas terrorist, Netanyahu, Eisenkot chasing him
item.description: Palombo explained that his intention to politicize Bart’s character in his new work signifies the indoctrination of minors, jihadist propaganda, and the transmission of violence to new generations.

item.title: UN rights council condemns attacks on civilians in Sudan, calls for truce
item.description: Resolution demands an immediate ceasefire and extends the mandate of the mission investigating abuses in Sudan.
